narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Personal Experience -> Business Lesson -> Legal Warning.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The speaker shares her personal experience as an entrepreneur to warn viewers about the dangers of registering company assets or shares under the names of others, including spouses or family members. She emphasizes the legal reality that registered ownership is often final in the eyes of the law, regardless of intent, especially during personal conflicts or breakups.
